text: gh-as-agent commit does NOT stage files (no implicit -a) — run git add <file> first or the commit reports 'no changes added to commit'.

GitHub Event Log session correlationId contract is trigger:<triggerId>:gh:<eventId> (stamped by agent-entrypoint.py _execute_inner). To match a session: active sessions carry a single correlationId; finished sessions carry a correlationIds[] SET (grouped by Claude session-id since #555). Match active first, else history, else show a non-blocking not-found banner (never a blank view).
